title: Image file
description: References an image [File](/docs/api-reference/files) in the content of a message.

file_id.description: The [File](/docs/api-reference/files) ID of the image in the message content. Set `purpose="vision"` when uploading the File if you need to later display the file content.

detail.description: Specifies the detail level of the image if specified by the user. `low` uses fewer tokens, you can opt in to high resolution using `high`.
